text: e& (Emirates Telecommunications Group Company PJSC, formerly Etisalat) is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority (EIA), which a filing signed by both calls an integral part of the UAE's Federal Government. e&'s corporate governance report for 2019 calls EIA the Government Shareholder, with the right to appoint seven of the eleven board members.
short: e& is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority, part of the UAE's federal government

source.name: SEC: Schedule 13D/A, Vodafone Group Plc, filed by Atlas 2022 Holdings, Emirates Telecommunications Group Company PJSC and Emirates Investment Authority
source.quote: Atlas Holdings is a wholly-owned subsidiary of e&, which in turn is 60% owned by EIA
source.note: The filing also says: 'EIA is an integral part of the Federal Government and was established through Federal Decree Law No. 4 of 2007'. sec.gov blocks the source checker; read with the SEC's requested User-Agent.

additionalSources.name: e& (Etisalat Group): Corporate Governance Report 2019
additionalSources.quote: The Government Shareholder (Emirates Investment Authority “EIA” or any other body constituted as government representative in the Company by virtue of a Cabinet Resolution) has the right to appoint 7 Board Members
additionalSources.note: Section 15.2 of the same report (shareholders holding 5% and above of Etisalat shares at the end of 2019) lists Emirates Investment Authority (EIA) with 60%, 5,218,052,400 shares.

additionalSources.name: AGBI: Etisalat / e& News and Company Profile
additionalSources.quote: The ownership structure changed in 1983 when the UAE government held a 60% share. The remainder is publicly traded
